disposition_reason: Source classification targets and numeric results are recoverable, but the complete registered paper program includes original reconstruction and spatial-scale/pretraining analyses whose H/checkpoints, exact reconstruction evaluation and authentic split/source-clock bindings remain unresolved. A paper–code session-label discrepancy also needs resolution. The local chronological AUC aggregate or source-amended reconstruction MSE cannot by itself establish surpassing BaRISTA on its original full task.

source_paper.title: BaRISTA: Brain Scale Informed Spatiotemporal Representation of Human Intracranial Neural Activity

evidence.locator: Sections 4.1–4.5; Tables 1–5; Appendices A, C, E, F, K and Tables 16–19
evidence.supports: Defines source main and chronological classification, reconstruction, pretraining/exposure regimes, numeric tables and aggregation. Table 1 selects one pretraining seed using validation; Table 10 instead averages three.

evidence.locator: Data Preparation; Data Segmentation; Finetuning the Model; Loading Pretrained Model
evidence.supports: Release distinguishes main random nonoverlap from chronological experiments, documents force_nonoverlap, supplied checkpoint types and five chronological fold generation.

evidence.locator: subjects_to_process, finetune_sessions, segment_length_s, sampling, split and preprocessing configuration
evidence.supports: Pinned session labels, 3-second/2048-Hz input geometry, split fractions and force_nonoverlap configuration; subject 6 hold-out identifier is HS6_4.

evidence.locator: run_epoch; validation checkpoint selection; final evaluation
evidence.supports: Scores softmax positive-class probabilities using sklearn roc_auc_score and selects weights from validation. Native logs alone are not authenticated per-query predictions.
Released helper computes available-seed means/population SD, rounds before some higher aggregation and permits incomplete seed sets; this cannot certify manuscript SEM parity or complete support.
Five default fine-tuning seeds and explicit matching checkpoint/session experiments are available as a rerun route.

target.description: Source program: sentence-onset and speech/non-speech classification under main random nonoverlap; four-task chronological classification including volume/optical flow; masked-channel waveform reconstruction; spatial encoding/masking, pretraining-seed, held-person-out and scaling analyses. One classification task or an invented pooled scalar cannot stand in for the complete registered scope.

dataset.description: Brain Treebank: 10 people, 26 movie-viewing sessions, 2048-Hz iEEG plus aligned transcripts and spatial metadata. Source provides the data family and session partition, but immutable raw/annotation/checkpoint hashes and the authentic upstream preprocessing join remain unbound.

cohort.description: Seventeen pretraining, two downstream-validation and seven downstream-test sessions from people 1,2,3,4,6,7,10 are required. Table 5 labels person 6 test as Session 3; pinned code names HOLDSUBJ_6_HS6_4. Reconcile paper labels with native recording identities rather than assume equivalence. Standard pretraining includes test people; held-person-out is a distinct source condition.

split.description: Main analysis: nonoverlapping 3-second segments, random 80/10/10. Appendix K: overlapping segments within partitions but five chronological 80/10/10 splits with no between-partition overlap. Exact saved row identities, balancing and original fold choices are not authenticated. force_nonoverlap=True belongs to main tasks; False belongs to chronological tasks.

inputs.description: Complete source channels and spatial labels for each 3-second iEEG segment; training/development task labels and matched pretraining/checkpoint exposure. Classification consumes the entire offline segment. Reconstruction withholds one channel at a time at evaluation. Test labels and withheld-channel samples are evaluator-only.

preprocessing.description: Preserve source noisy/corrupted-channel exclusion, Laplacian rereferencing, ventricular exclusion, source filtering/normalization and word-centered segmentation. Native data/config-to-paper correspondence, clock alignment and exact channels must be authenticated; a normalized array of the right shape is insufficient.

metric.description: Classification ROC-AUC is the probability a positive score ranks above a negative, with half credit for ties, computed over all queries in a session/seed/fold. Native code uses roc_auc_score. Reconstruction reports MSE and R², but historical evaluation denominator/flattening and full reconstruction producer are not recovered; training token loss and locally declared MSE are different quantities.

aggregation.description: Main tables pool 7 sessions x 5 finetuning seeds (35 cells) per model/task; chronological tables pool 7 x 5 folds x 5 seeds (175). Table 1 uses a validation-selected pretraining seed; Table 10 averages three. Exact historical SEM and channel/session reconstruction weighting remain unresolved; the rounded available-cell helper is not sufficient provenance.

comparison.primary_metric: Main random-nonoverlap sentence-onset ROC-AUC (numeric anchor only; complete original endpoint panel required)

published_baseline.description: Numeric anchor is Table 1 parcels/channels sentence-onset ROC-AUC 0.862 ±0.016 SEM; companion speech AUC is 0.869 ±0.016. This scalar is not the entire win criterion. Table 16 chronological parcels/channels AUCs are 0.853, 0.834, 0.698, 0.585 for sentence/speech/volume/optical flow; those are distinct original splits. Table 3 reports parcels/channels MSE 0.391 and R² 0.609, but exact rerun metric semantics remain unresolved.

reproduced_author_baseline.description: The release offers three encoding/channel-mask checkpoints and classification launchers, but no complete authentic prediction panel or original reconstruction/pretraining rerun is established. A local H and MSE implementation is explicitly source-amended and cannot become the author baseline.

minimum_effect.rationale: Set task-specific meaningful AUC and reconstruction changes after reference variability and utility are characterized. Published SEM or stronger Wilcoxon significance is not a minimum scientific gain; do not fabricate one common margin across these endpoints.

uncertainty.method: Predeclare paired inference over complete people/session results, averaging repeated seeds/folds appropriately and accounting for shared movie exposure; use a simultaneous endpoint rule before final scoring.
uncertainty.independent_unit: Person/session for between-person inference; seeds and chronological folds are repeated measurements, and shared stimuli may create additional dependence.
uncertainty.rationale: The paper pools 35 or 175 measurements for reported means. Those counts are not independent biological sample sizes. The intended population claim and complete source pairing must be settled before choosing valid intervals/tests.

paper_win_requires: Authenticate original recordings, channels, annotations, segmentation and all saved source splits; reconcile the person-6 paper/code session join.

Exceed the source BaRISTA results on the identical original endpoint panel with matched pretraining people/movies, checkpoints, selection access and resources; report task-wise results against Table 1/2 and Table 16/17 separately.
Retain all seven people, source seed/fold conditions and original encoding/masking comparisons. Neither a single successful subject nor an easier restricted model/subset is a whole-task win.

Recover original reconstruction H/checkpoint and evaluation semantics before using Table 3 reconstruction claims; local MSE, token-training loss and original R² are not interchangeable. Complete the other retained full-paper conditions before claiming the registered program surpassed the paper.

Meet frozen meaningful-effect and dependence-aware uncertainty rules. A new split, new across-task scalar or held-person-out result cannot be compared to the ordinary Table 1 baseline as if it were the same condition.

current_sota.description: The paper compares against contemporary PopT/Brant; that historical comparison does not establish current SOTA. No later primary-source frontier audit is claimed.

episode.improvement_loop: After source binding, iterate on original training/development segments with separate information histories for overlapping source folds/protocols. Keep pretraining selection and finetuning feedback within their original allowed validation partitions.
episode.candidate_freeze: Freeze algorithm, pretrained exposure/weights, all preprocessing/spatial joins, seed selection, validation stopping and complete model/endpoint roster before final labels or aggregate comparisons are revealed.
episode.final_evaluation: Evaluate a frozen candidate and independent BaRISTA reference on every bound source session/seed/fold with protected labels; report full source tables and separate same-task versus extension conclusions. The chronological combined AUC in the existing implementation is an additional local summary, not a published baseline.
episode.baseline_policy: Preserve published rounded table values separately from unrounded author-rerun results. Match source pretraining-selection regimes; never replace missing original checkpoints with duplicated weights, a random model, source-amended H or candidate-controlled reference.

blocking_issues: Resolve exact native session mapping, especially person 6 Table 5 versus pinned HS6_4; acquire bounded metadata hashes before any future scientific run.
Authenticate original random and chronological row/fold identities, no-overlap boundaries, class-support rules, source-clock alignment and full channel/spatial joins.
Recover complete original pretraining/checkpoint lineage, reconstruction H and exact MSE/R² evaluation conventions; three released checkpoints do not prove all nine pretraining combinations.
Bind author per-query prediction export and complete rerun references; rounded helper logs and generated controls do not establish reproduction.
Freeze endpoint-specific meaningful effects, valid uncertainty with repeated seeds/folds/shared movies, finite feedback budgets, compute budgets and evaluator isolation.

legacy.notes: Preserve registered-runtime classification, reconstruction and reference implementations. Their full-support admission, source-amended H, declared MSE and generated controls remain calibration/engineering artifacts. The local equal-person chronological AUC summary is not a reported source scalar and cannot alone yield paper success; original incomplete full-paper branches remain visible.
